title: Chapter 244 Finally Back
content:
Chapter 244 Finally Back

On the other hand, Jordan Yang was in trouble.

I saw Jordan Yangsheng lying flat on the ground with no desire, his face alternately with bruises and swollen. At this moment, even if Lu Xue stood here, he would not be able to recognize Jordan Yang.

What's wrong with this world?

Is the treatment of an alchemist like this?

I didn't say anything, I rewarded a massage package first?

At this moment, he wanted to argue, but feeling the constant pain coming from his body, Jordanyang sighed in his heart and lay quietly on the ground.

From the heart.

That's it, I don't know how long it took.

"Hey, why are you still lying down? Are you trying to mess around?!"

Wanfeng walked to Jordanyang, kicked Jordanyang, and then said fiercely.

Upon hearing this, Jordanyang immediately stood up and swallowed a pill.

In just an instant, Jordan Yang's injuries began to recover quickly.

But for some reason, the bruises on the face recovered extremely slowly, as if something was hindering the spread of the medicinal power.

An Feng chuckled in his heart at this.

I deliberately used a little taboo force to hit it. If I want to recover completely, I don’t think about it if I don’t have ten days or half a month.

At this moment, Jordan Yang didn't know the power of taboos, but he was a little puzzled.

Probably it's just that the injury is too serious.

Then Jordanyang unconsciously took two steps back and looked at Wanfeng not far away in front of him with a vigilant look on his face.

"Who are you? I have no grudges and grudges with you. Why did you attack me?"

Faced with Jordanyang's questioning, Wanfeng innocently spread his hands.

"This old gentleman is just taking orders to act, and I have no way to tell you what you ask."

Act on order?

Hearing this, Jordan Yang suddenly reacted.

I have been wandering in the deserted city for half a day and found out in advance.

The lord of this Huangcheng City is just himself trying to find Lu Daosheng.

I originally wanted to go directly to the city lord's mansion to see Lu Daosheng himself, but I didn't expect it would be fine if I didn't see Lu Daosheng, but I also met the unreasonable woman in front of me and was beaten for nothing.

Now, the woman in front of him told him that he was acting on order.

If you follow someone's order, you still have to think about it. It must be that Lu Daosheng!

But why did the other party do this?

For a moment, Jordan Yang's heart was filled with countless doubts.

At this moment, he could not have thought that he would make Lu Daosheng's daughter Lu Xue unhappy just because of the alchemy, which made Lu Daosheng dissatisfied.

With Lu Daosheng's identity and strength, he naturally would not argue with Bai Lushuang.

Therefore, Lu Daosheng had to make fun of him.

For Lu Daosheng, Lu Daosheng didn't even need to do it himself.

At this time, Wan Feng's face changed, and he immediately smiled and said, "Old sir, sit down and have a cup of tea. Your purpose should be to meet our city lord."

Lu Daosheng just asked her to beat this guy up and didn't say anything else.

That means that there may be only a little friction between the two parties and there is no hostility.

And this guy didn't cause trouble when he came here, so Wan Feng showed a little kindness.

When Jordanyang heard Wan Feng's words, he had no expression on his face.

I just beat myself up, but now I'm letting myself sit down and have tea. The injuries on my face have not healed yet.

You really think you have no temper, right?

Jordanyang snorted coldly, turned his head away and ignored it.

After a moment.

Jordan Yang sat upright in front of the stone table in the courtyard, holding a cup of steaming hot and fragrant tea in his hand.

This tea is caused by the leaves on the Enlightenment Tree.

It can refresh the mind and even enhance the understanding of the creatures.

It is a rare treasure.

But at this moment, Jordan Yang was unconscious to taste it because there were a few more fresh injuries on his face.

Wan Feng faced Jordanyang, drinking Wudao Tea with intoxicated expression while looking at Jordanyang in front of him with a faint smile.

In this way, after a long wait, Jordanyang finally waited.

At this time, above the void of the deserted city.

Three figures stood in it, looking down at the giant city below.

"This is my deserted city, how about it?"

Lu Daosheng smiled and spoke boldly.

On the side, the master and disciple of Shi Liantian also looked at the luxurious giant city below with a look of amazement, with glitter in their eyes.

Sure enough, how could a person like Lu Daosheng be an ordinary force?

Even in the Immortal Realm, I'm afraid there is no such luxurious power.

"There is no one in this city."

Shi Liantian commented.

"So big."

Yuanyuan also commented.

Suddenly, the two of them looked at Yuanyuan at the same time.

"What, what's wrong?"

Looking at the strange gazes of the two, a big question mark appeared on Yuanyuan's head.

"fine."

The two of them looked back.

"Follow me to the city."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and the terrifying law of forbidden air on the deserted city faded toward both sides like a tide.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng took the lead, stepped on the void, and strode towards the city lord's mansion in the city.

Seeing this, Shi Liantian and the others behind him did not hesitate and hurriedly followed.

In the city lord's mansion.

Jordanyang and Wanfeng looked up at the void at the same time.

Wanfeng's mouth rose slightly and he immediately stood up.

Jordan Yang's expression gradually became solemn.

Finally here?

At this moment, as a top alchemist in the Immortal Realm, he became a little nervous.

Buzz —

At this time, the space in front of the two people suddenly cracked.

The next moment, three figures slowly stepped out from the crack in the space.

"Master, you are back."

Wanfeng stepped forward and said.

Lu Daosheng nodded, and then noticed Jordanyang behind Wan Feng.

At this moment, Jordanyang did not look at Lu Daosheng.

Instead, he looked at Shi Liantian behind Lu Daosheng with a serious face.

"You, why do you give me a familiar feeling?"

Hearing this, Shi Liantian turned his head and looked at Jordanyang. When he saw Jordanyang, Shi Liantian had a expressionless face and ignored him at all.

Seeing this, although Jordanyang was a little dissatisfied, he did not dare to express it.

If it were before, I would have cursed myself at this moment.

As an alchemist or a top alchemist, his temper is naturally ridiculously great.

But now, after Anfeng’s “massage” education, Jordanyang has obviously restrained his temper.

Lu Daosheng also noticed the mark on Jordanyang's face and couldn't help but laugh.

This Anhui wind is really not a hit.

At this time, Jordanyang finally looked at Lu Daosheng.

If Wan Feng hadn't spoken just now, he wouldn't have seen that this was Lu Daosheng, the lord of Huangcheng.

Because in his impression, Lu Daosheng is a powerful alchemy, how could he be such a young person?

In contrast, the sloppy old man behind Lu Daosheng looked more like an alchemist.

As an alchemist, Jordanyang could feel the alchemy achievements of the old man in front of him.

It's very likely to be above yourself.

In this way, everything will be figured out.

The pill was indeed given to her by Lu Xue's father Lu Daosheng, but it was not refined by Lu Daosheng himself, but by the alchemist around Lu Daosheng.

That's true. How could such a large force not have their own alchemist?
